To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the perceived usefulness, ease of use and trust are significant predictors of attitude and behavioral intention.
the retail employee's attitude towards IoT adoption is significantly influenced by their perception of usefulness and ease of use.
the retail employees' attitude and behavioral intention to use IoT is significantly influenced by perceived usefulness, ease of use, trust and subjective norm.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the adoption of IoT in retail environment and its impact on employees’ attitude towards IoT adoption.
the acceptance and use behavior of IoT in retail environments and its impact on employee's attitude.
the factors that determine the intention to accept IoT technology by retail employees and the factors that determine their attitude and intention towards using the technology.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the TAM model can be used to predict and explain the adoption of IoT by the retail employees.

the proposed model is a valid model to predict retail employee's behavioral intention to use IoT in the future and the proposed model is also a valid model for predicting retail employees' attitude towards IoT adoption.
the proposed research model is valid and reliable and the findings are consistent with the existing literature.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the results of this research can help the retailers to understand the factors that influence the adoption of IoT by retail employees and the factors that affect the employees' attitude towards the adoption of IoT in the retail environment.
the TAM is an important model for the adoption of IoT in retail stores, and the model can be further extended by adding trust, perceived behavior controls and subjective norms to the basic TAM model.
the results of this study indicate that perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness and subjective norm are the main factors that affect attitude towards IoT adoption and behavioral intention.

the perceived behavior control and trust have a positive impact on attitude towards IoT adoption and subjective norm has a significant impact on attitude.
trust, subjective norm and perceived behavior control are the most important determinants of attitude towards IoT and that attitude is the most important determinant of behavioral intention.
trust is the key driver of attitude and behavioral intention to adopt IoT in the retail environment.
